provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Clans of Caledonia rulebook (Karma Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Build the map from the 4 modules, each on a random side, letters A-D clockwise with their rocks meeting in the middle
4 random Port bonus tiles, one next to the factory at each corner on the space for your player count
Market board on the side for your player count; Price markers on the circled starting prices; goods in piles below
Export board on the side for your player count; 5 random Scoring tiles faceup in its slots
Shuffle the Export contracts; 1 faceup on each box
steps.note: Solo and 3 players: one box stays empty

steps.text: Glory tokens and Import tokens beside the board
Player board with 4 each of Sheep, Cows, Cheese Dairies, Bakeries, Fields and Distilleries
8 Workers: 4 on the forest spots (Woodcutters), 4 on the mountain spots (Miners); take 4 Port markers
5 Merchants on the Merchant track, the other 2 below your board
Shipping token on the leftmost space; 2 Technology tiles arrow side up below the Workers
An Export box tile on the side for your player count
Random starting player; Turn order tokens clockwise on the Turn order track
Draw Clan tiles equal to players + 1, a random Starting tile beside each; in reverse turn order each picks a pair and takes its goods and money
In turn order each places 1 Worker, then in reverse order a second - paying the land cost plus 6 for a Woodcutter or 10 for a Miner
